en.title: Lae'zel Actor Devora Wilde Discovered Space Marine 2 Role Via Fans
en.summary: Devora Wilde, beloved for her portrayal of Lae'zel in Baldur's Gate 3, recently revealed a surprising detail about her career. She was unaware of her own participation in the upcoming Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 until players themselves pointed it out.
en.body:
For fans of **Baldur's Gate 3**, **Devora Wilde** is synonymous with the fierce Githyanki warrior Lae'zel. However, Wilde's extensive resume in the gaming world extends far beyond Faerûn, encompassing titles like **Solasta 2**, **Crimson Desert**, and **Cyberpunk 2077**. Yet, even with a notable presence in multiple games, a recent revelation points to a peculiar gap in her awareness: she didn't know she was in **Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2** until its release.

Wilde shared in an interview that she began receiving comments from players after the game launched, expressing surprise at her involvement. Initially, she was taken aback, questioning the claims. It wasn't until a fan shared a clip on Twitter that she connected the dots, having to meticulously sift through emails and match codenames to the actual project. This practice of withholding game titles from actors during development is common, a measure taken by studios to prevent leaks.

## A Familiar Universe, An Unfamiliar Name

Wilde's connection to the Warhammer universe is already well-established, with previous roles including Tzarina Katarin Bokha in **Total War: Warhammer 3**, the Authoritarian voice for the female Arbitrator in **Darktide**, and a Sister of Battle in the **Adepta Sororitas** animation **Penitence**. Despite this, she admitted to not fully grasping the vastness of the Warhammer lore until recently. Her role in **Space Marine 2** involved multiple characters, including a servo-skull and a Cadian soldier whose audio logs players encounter. It was hearing one of these audio logs that finally confirmed her own voice and presence in the game.

## The Actor's Perspective on Game Development

This situation echoes Wilde's experience with the **Silent Hill 2** remake, where she performed motion capture and stunts. She only realized which game she was working on after recognizing familiar dialogue and conducting her own online research. This underscores a common industry practice where actors might not be privy to the full project details until much later in the process, if at all. For players deeply invested in the games and the actors who bring characters to life, this behind-the-scenes reality adds another layer of intrigue to their favorite titles.

## What's Next

While **Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2** is slated for release in 2026, specific details regarding future roles for Devora Wilde have not yet been announced, though her extensive work suggests more exciting projects are likely on the horizon.

tr.title: Lae'zel Oyuncusu Devora Wilde, Space Marine 2 Rolünü Hayranlardan Öğrenmiş
tr.summary: Baldur's Gate 3'te Lae'zel karakterine hayat veren Devora Wilde, şaşırtıcı bir açıklama yaptı. Space Marine 2'de yer aldığını oyuncuların kendisiyle paylaşmasıyla öğrenmiş. Wilde'nin oyun dünyasındaki geniş deneyimi, Solasta 2, Crimson Desert ve Cyberpunk 2077 gibi oyunları içeriyor.
tr.body:
Baldur's Gate 3 hayranları için Devora Wilde, güçlü Githyanki savaşçı Lae'zel ile eş anlamlı. Ancak Wilde'nin oyun dünyasındaki geniş deneyimi Faerûn'un ötesine geçiyor ve **Solasta 2**, **Crimson Desert**, **Cyberpunk 2077** gibi oyunları içeriyor. Son açıklamaları ise dikkat çekici bir ayrıntıyı ortaya koyuyor: **Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2**'de yer aldığını, oyunun çıkmasının ardından oyuncuların yorumlarından öğrenmiş.

## Tanıdık Bir Evren, Tanımadık Bir İsim
Wilde, **Total War: Warhammer 3**'te Tzarina Katarin Bokha, **Darktide**'da female Arbitrator ve **Adepta Sororitas** animasyon **Penitence**'de bir Sister of Battle olarak Warhammer evreniyle zaten bağlantılı. Buna rağmen, Warhammer lore'un genişliğini最近 keşfetmeye başlamış. **Space Marine 2**'deki rolü, bir servo-skull ve oyuncuların karşılaştığı audio log'lara sahip bir Cadian askerini içeriyor. Bu audio log'lardan birini duyması, nihayetinde kendi sesini ve oyun中的 varlığını potvriliyor.

## Oyuncu Perspektifinden Oyun Geliştirme
Bu durum, Wilde'nin **Silent Hill 2** remake'inde motion capture ve stunts yaptığı deneyimi yansıtıyor. Hangi oyun üzerinde çalıştığını, tanıdık diyalogları tanıdığı ve kendi araştırmalarını yaptığı zaman öğrenmiş. Bu, oyuncuların favori oyunlarına karşı daha da büyük bir ilgi duyduğu bir endüstri uygulamasını vurguluyor.

## Devam Eden Projeler
**Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2** 2026'da çıkacak olsa da, Devora Wilde'nin gelecekteki rolleri hakkında具体 detaylar henüz açıklanmadı. Geniş çalışma deneyimi, önümüzdeki dönemde daha heyecan verici projelerin geleceğini gösteriyor.

content_raw: Devora Wilde has been in loads of videogames. While she's most famous for playing Lae'zel, everyone's hot gith girlfriend in Baldur's Gate 3, she's also been in games like Solasta 2, Clair Obscur, Crimson Desert, Split Fiction, and Red Solstice 2. She's in Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 as well—not that she knew about it at the time. "I started getting comments when the game came out, 'Oh, you're in Space Marine 2!' I was like, 'No, I'm not. What is that?'" Wilde said in an interview with IGN . It was only after someone on Twitter sent her a clip of the performance that she realized it was true. "I had to go through like all my stuff, all my emails, try and match up the codename of the game with the actual game. And then in the end I realized I was in that game." It's common for actors not to be told the name of games they're working on until the last minute, if at all, for fear of leaks. When Wilde auditioned for a role in Silent Hill 2, in which she ended up performing mocap and stunts, she only twigged what game it was after thinking some of the dialogue sounded familiar then looking it up online. Wilde played multiple roles in Space Marine 2, including a servo-skull and a Cadian soldier whose messages you find. It was a recording of the latter that convinced her she really was in Space Marine 2. "'I was like, 'Oh, that's me. I'm an audio log.'" Wilde has been in several Warhammer games and animations. She plays Tzarina Katarin Bokha in Total War: Warhammer 3, provides the Authoritarian voice option for the female Arbitrator in Darktide, and she was one of the Sisters of Battle in the Adepta Sororitas animation Penitence on Warhammer TV. "It just so happens that I've done a lot of Warhammer stuff," Wilde said, "and I never realized how vast the universe is, genuinely."
